name: Monke's Nightmare!
summary: Deep within a ruined research facility, you navigate a winding maze of collapsed corridors, abandoned labs, and dark machinery left humming with forgotten purpose. The air feels heavy, carrying the metallic scent of old blood and rusted tools. Scattered documents hint at a project pushed far beyond ethical limits, where scientists attempted to rewrite biology itself. Their experiments, malformed and suffering, now roam the halls with exposed organs, torn skin, and movements that sound painfully unnatural. E
